mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_customer WHERE deleted = 0 AND (customer_status IS NULL OR customer_status != 'LOST')
SELECT COUNT(1) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(amount_base), 0) AS amount_base FROM t_opportunity WHERE deleted = 0 AND stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST')
SELECT AS period, COUNT(1) AS count FROM t_customer WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY period

SELECT AS period, COUNT(1) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN stage = 'WON' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won, SUM(CASE WHEN stage IN ('WON', 'LOST') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS decided, COALESCE(SUM(amount_base), 0) AS amount_base FROM t_opportunity WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY period

SELECT c.source AS source, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS opportunity_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount_base), 0) AS opportunity_amount_base FROM t_customer c LEFT JOIN t_opportunity o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE c.deleted = 0 GROUP BY c.source
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount_base), 0) FROM t_order WHERE AND YEAR(create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE())
SELECT AS period, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount_base), 0) AS amount_base FROM t_order WHERE GROUP BY period
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN o.total_amount IS NULL OR o.total_amount = 0 THEN GREATEST(r.receivable_amount - r.received_amount, 0) ELSE GREATEST(r.receivable_amount - r.received_amount, 0) * o.total_amount_base / o.total_amount END
r.deleted = 0 AND (r.receivable_status IS NULL OR r.receivable_status <> 'PAID') AND r.receivable_amount > r.received_amount
mapper.select: SELECT r.due_date AS due_date, AS amount_base FROM t_receivable r JOIN t_order o ON o.id = r.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(), 0) FROM t_receivable r JOIN t_order o ON o.id = r.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 WHERE AND r.due_date IS NOT NULL AND r.due_date < CURDATE()

SELECT MIN(i.product_id) AS product_id, COALESCE(p.product_name, MAX(i.product_name)) AS product_name, p.product_code AS product_code, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.total_amount IS NULL OR o.total_amount = 0 THEN i.amount ELSE i.amount * o.total_amount_base / o.total_amount END), 0) AS deal_amount_base, COALESCE(SUM(i.quantity), 0) AS deal_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS order_count FROM t_order_item i JOIN t_order o ON o.id = i.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN t_crm_product p ON p.id = i.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND o.order_status <> 'CANCELLED' GROUP BY COALESCE(i.product_id, CONCAT('#', i.product_name)), p.product_code, p.product_name ORDER BY deal_amount_base DESC, deal_quantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}
